title: Framing Effects in Independent-Agent Large Language Models: A Cross-Family Behavioral Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Administering a threshold voting task using two logically equivalent prompts with different linguistic framings (individual survival vs. collective survival) and calculating the difference in choice probability to measure framing-induced shifts.
Analyzing the frequency of LLMs selecting a deterministic, safe option over a conditional, risk-bearing cooperative option under independent-agent conditions.
